svg.aria-label: The Ark — a cogwheel-encircled cyberpunk citadel rendered as a Codex Atlanticus pen-and-ink plate
svg.title: Plate I — The Ark
svg.desc: An ink-line drawing in the style of Leonardo da Vinci's Codex folios: a sixteen-toothed cogwheel encloses a hatched mountain horizon, a central observation tower with antenna array, a horizontal truss bridge, and a small network of signal nodes. Margin annotations and construction guides surround the central form.

g.text: PLATE · I — A SMALL CRAFT FOR WHAT IS WORTH CARRYING FORWARD
